title: Communication Arts and Sciences, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Built from the archived 2023-24 bulletin's own Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements tabs, cross-checked by hand-summing the page's own per-semester subtotals (16+16+16+15+15+15+15+12=120) against its own stated 'Total Credits 120' line rather than trusting WebFetch's summary alone. Real, verified differences from the 2025/2026 plan for this same major: (1) LA 83 and LA 283 do not exist in this catalog year -- Semester 1 and Semester 2 are plain 16cr/16cr, not 17.5cr/16cr; those two seminar credits were only added starting with the 2025-26 edition (see CASBA-2025.json). (2) The Gen Ed slot the current plan calls 'World Cultures' is printed as 'Other Cultures' in this catalog year's own table (renamed by PSU between the 2023-24 and 2024-25 editions -- see CASBA-2024.json, which already shows the new name with an otherwise-identical structure). (3) Total credits are 120, not 123, because this year's Fourth Year Spring semester has only four 3cr items (two CAS 4XX-level courses plus two Electives = 12cr) versus the 2022-23 catalog's five items/15cr (see CASBA-2022.json) -- this year's structure is the one that persisted unchanged (aside from the label rename and the later LA 83/283 addition) through 2024-25 and into the credit-neutral 2025-26 restructuring. Everything else -- the CAS 301/303/304/311 core, the CAS Additional Course pool (CAS 203/210/215/220, confirmed identical in this year's own Program Requirements tab), the CAS 4XX-level and Supporting CAS course match patterns, the CAS 100A/100B/100C cross-listed intro option, the ENGL 202A-D pool, entrance-to-the-major language (2.00 GPA), and the Communication Studies (Berks/Brandywine, 15cr, CAS 204) vs. Foundations Scholarship and Practice (University Park, 18cr, this plan's own modeled option) split -- is byte-identical to the current 2026 plan's own already-verified modeling, so those parts were carried over unchanged rather than re-derived. Campus tag mirrors the 2026 plan (University Park + Brandywine, Pattern A per docs/BRANCH_CAMPUS_FINDINGS.md); not independently re-verified against a 2023-era Brandywine-specific page beyond confirming this major's core+option structure was unchanged since 2022 on the Liberal Arts page checked directly. Elective-pool and Gen Ed domain slots remain unenforced placeholders, same convention as the current plan.
